step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram represents FINRA's user analytics platform on AWS. 1. Internal platform processes (Data Mgmt ETL) copy prepped data into an S3 Analytics Data Lake. 2. A Market Regulation Analyst submits a query request via ECS. 3. ECS kicks off a Hive EMR job to read from the main S3 Data Lake and output a targeted Data Mart into another S3 bucket. 4. ECS performs introspection on the Data Mart in S3 to assess query complexity (columns, row count, size). 5. ECS routes the execution request to either a Presto EMR cluster (for simpler queries) or a Redshift cluster (for complex queries with extensive joins). 6. Presto EMR or Redshift then queries/pulls the data from the Data Mart S3 bucket to deliver interactive analytics to the user.
